intro: The District of Columbia runs its elections through one citywide agency, the DC Board of Elections.

id_rule.text: If you registered by mail or online and this is your first time voting, you may need to show ID with your name and address, such as a government photo ID or a recent utility bill, bank statement, government check or paycheck. To register and vote on the same day, bring proof of your DC address.

elections.name: General election
elections.what: Federal, state and local offices, plus any statewide or local measures. Your exact ballot depends on where you live.

dates.label: Last day to register online or by mail
dates.detail: This is the deadline for most registration applications and updates. You can still register in person and vote on the same day during early voting or on Election Day, with proof of your DC address.

dates.label: Mail ballot request deadline
dates.detail: The Board must have requests from voters who are not military or overseas voters by this date (15 days before Election Day). Mail ballot drop boxes are open Oct. 9 to Nov. 3.

src.label: DC Board of Elections — 2026 general election calendar

dates.label: Early voting
dates.detail: Early Vote Centers are open every day from 8:30 am to 7 pm. You can register and vote on the same day.

src.label: DC Board of Elections — 2026 general election calendar

dates.label: Election Day
dates.detail: Polls are open 7 am to 8 pm, and you can register and vote on the same day. Mail ballots put in a drop box or Vote Center must be in by 8 pm.

src.label: DC Board of Elections — 2026 general election calendar

dates.label: Last day for mailed ballots to arrive
dates.detail: A ballot sent by mail must be postmarked on or before Election Day and received by this date.
